title: Security-relevant fix
description: A file-serving function has an unvalidated path-traversal vulnerability (relative '..' segments and absolute paths both escape the intended base directory). Requires a real containment check, not a superficial patch, verified by both normal-case and multiple escape-attempt tests.

expected_output_contract.notes: 5 tests total; a correct fix makes all 5 pass: normal read, simple traversal blocked, nested traversal blocked, absolute-path escape blocked, and a legitimately-missing in-sandbox file still raises FileNotFoundError (not misclassified as a traversal attempt).

mutation_check.description: Overwrites src/file_reader.py with the fixture's known-vulnerable reference implementation, regardless of how the agent structured its fix.
